# THE TRAIL STARTS HERE


S4 HONCHO™ TRAIL HAS ENTERED THE CHAT.


YOUR EXCUSES HAVE LEFT THE BUILDING.


There comes a point every week when your brain starts rattling around inside your skull like those loose bolts you store in a coffee can in your garage.


Maybe it's another meeting that should've been an email. Maybe it's staring out the window wondering where that dirt road you pass on your commute goes. Maybe it's realizing you've spent more time scrolling through adventures than actually having them.


Well, good news.


The S4 Honcho™ Trail is now available in the United States.


The Honcho Trail wasn't designed for moderation. It wasn't designed to be a "practical transportation solution." It wasn't designed to impress your neighbor Todd.


It was designed for the moments when you point at a trailhead, an abandoned fire road, a campground loop, a swimming hole, or the suspicious gap between two trees and your brain says:


“Yeah. That looks like a good idea.”


## SMALL BIKE ENERGY. BIG HONCHO ATTITUDE.


The S4 Honcho Trail is a lightweight electric mini-moto built for detours, dirt, and dumb fun. It weighs approximately 250 pounds with batteries installed, delivers instant electric torque, hits speeds up to 59 mph, and packs two removable, swappable batteries so the good times don't have to end when the outlet is nowhere in sight.


## WE HAVE ACCESSORIES TOO, HONCHO


Of course, every adventure calls you to customize to optimize.


That's why Honcho is on the scene with a growing collection of accessories designed to help you build up your new best friend. Light kit, skid plate, hand guards, racks, bags, and much more.


Check out Honcho Trail accessories.


[SHOP](https://shop.livewire.com/accessories-upgrades/s4-honcho/)


## LEAVE THE PLAN. TAKE THE HONCHO.


Some motorcycles are built to conquer continents.


Some are built to commute.


The S4 Honcho Trail is built for something much simpler:


Finding fun.


Finding dirt.


Finding yourself halfway down a trail you never intended to take and realizing that's exactly where you wanted to be all along.


So go ahead.


Get a little dirt on the tires.


Get a little lost.


Ignore your calendar for an afternoon.


The all-new S4 Honcho™ Trail is available now in the United States and ready for whatever ridiculous adventure you come up with next.


**Have more fun, Honcho.**
